rationale: The breakout above the $10.00 whole-dollar level has failed, with price stalling at $10.04 and dropping back to $9.97 while SPY continues to deteriorate (-4.16%). With only 10 minutes remaining before forced market liquidation and a 5m ATR of just $0.09, there is insufficient time and upward momentum to justify holding a losing long position into the final bell. Closing now preserves capital while avoiding shorting into the still-supportive 5m 9-EMA ($9.90) and session VWAP ($9.59).
